info.title: LAD Backend API
info.description:
Node.js / Express API for the LAD platform — auth, billing, users, campaigns,
ICP assistant, Apollo leads, WhatsApp/LinkedIn conversation proxies, ABM,
deals pipeline, voice agent, social integrations, community-ROI, and more.

Routes prefixed with `/api/:feature` are loaded dynamically by the feature registry.
Routes documented here are those statically mounted in `core/app.js` plus the
feature routers that ship with the repo at the time of writing.

info.title: VOAG — Vonage Voice Agent API
info.description:
Python / FastAPI multi-tenant voice agent platform with LiveKit integration.
Handles outbound AI voice calls, batch calling, voice agent config,
knowledge-base management (Gemini RAG), call recordings, Google and
Microsoft OAuth (for calendar bookings), and call analysis.

Located at `VOAG/` in the monorepo.
Entry point: `VOAG/main.py` — runs on port 8080 by default.

## Auth
All endpoints (except OAuth callbacks) require a tenant-scoped JWT in
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tenant ID is resolved from the JWT.

## Worker / background processing
Some operations (`/batch/trigger-batch-call`, `/calls/start-call`) enqueue
jobs to a background worker (`worker_server.py`). Status is polled via the
`/calls/status/{resource_id}` or `/batch/batch-status/{batch_id}` endpoints.

info.title: LAD Frontend API (Next.js Proxy Layer)
info.description:
Next.js App Router API routes (`web/src/app/api/**/route.ts`).
Most are thin proxies that read the `auth-token` cookie, forward to
LAD_backend (port 3004) or LAD-WABA-Comms (port 8000), and pass the response
back to the browser. A handful host real logic (Stripe checkout helpers,
contact form, gemini chat, recording proxy).

A catch-all router at `/api/[feature]/[...path]` forwards any unmatched
`/api/<feature>/...` request to LAD_backend's dynamic feature router. The
explicit routes below take precedence over the catch-all where their paths
overlap.

post.summary: Resolve email → tenant slug for SSO

get.summary: Proxy a recording URL with auth
Forward to LAD_backend feature router (any verb)
